Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
name: multi-container-pod
version: 1.0.0
description: A Helm chart for deploying a multi-container Pod with a sidecar

# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: nginx
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80
fluentBit:
  image:
    repository: fluent/fluent-bit
    tag: latest
  config:
    input:
      - name: tail
        tag: kube.*
        path: /var/log/containers/*.log
        db: /var/log/flb_kube.db
        mem_buf_limit: 10MB
        skip_long_lines: On
    filter:
      - name: kubernetes
        match: kube.*
        merge_json: log
        keep_time_key: On
    output:
      - name: es
        match: kube.*
        host: elasticsearch
        port: 9200
        index: logs
        type: log
        retry_limit: 5
        buffer:
          type: file
          path: /var/log/flb_es
          sync: normal
          chunk_limit_size: 5M
          queue_limit_size: 10M
volume:
  size: 1Gi

# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "multi-container-pod.labels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "multi-container-pod.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log
      - name: fluent-bit
        image: "{{ .Values.fluentBit.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.fluentBit.image.tag }}"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log
        - name: flb-config
          mountPath: /etc/fluent-bit
        - name: flb-db
          mountPath: /var/log/flb_kube.db
      volumes:
      - name: logs
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: flb-config
        configMap:
          name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}-flb-config
      - name: flb-db
        emptyDir: {}

# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}-flb-config
data:
  fluent-bit.conf: |
    [INPUT]
      name = tail
      tag = kube.*
      path = /var/log/containers/*.log
      db = /var/log/flb_kube.db
      mem_buf_limit = 10MB
      skip_long_lines = On
    [FILTER]
      name = kubernetes
      match = kube.*
      merge_json = log
      keep_time_key = On
    [OUTPUT]
      name = es
      match = kube.*
      host = elasticsearch
      port = 9200
      index = logs
      type = log
      retry_limit = 5
      buffer:
        type = file
        path = /var/log/flb_es
        sync = normal
        chunk_limit_size = 5M
        queue_limit_size = 10M

# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
  - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
  selector:
    {{- include "multi-container-pod.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
